units.source_text: “关于提亲的事情，我就此忘掉了。

en.t: I simply forgot about the matter of the marriage proposal.

units.source_text: 我观察过身边的同学，没有一个人像是拖家带口的，他们貌似都过着自由自在的独身生活。

en.t: When I looked at the classmates around me, not one of them seemed burdened with a family; they all appeared to be living free and easy single lives.

units.source_text: 若是深入了解，这群快活的年轻人中，或许也有人迫于家人压力已经娶妻的，然而天真单纯的我，没有发现这样的人。

en.t: Had I looked more deeply, there may have been some among those cheerful young men who had already married under family pressure, but in my innocent simplicity I noticed no such person.

units.source_text: 况且，这种有家累的人，也往往会顾忌别人的看法，尽量不去谈论那些跟学生生活无关的私事吧。

en.t: Besides, people with such family obligations would probably have been mindful of how others saw them and tried not to speak of private matters so unrelated to student life.

units.source_text: 后来我才意识到，自己已然属于这类人了，但当时竟没有丝毫觉察，仍然天真快活地行进在求学之道上。

en.t: Only later did I realize that I myself already belonged to that group, but at the time I was completely unaware of it and went on my path of study innocently and cheerfully.

units.source_text: 到了学年末，我又打起行李，回到了父母长眠的乡间。

en.t: At the end of the school year, I packed my luggage again and returned to the countryside where my parents slept in death.

units.source_text: 于是，同去年一样，在我父母曾经生活的家中，又见到了叔叔夫妇和堂弟堂妹们迎接我的笑脸。

en.t: There, just as the year before, in the house where my parents had once lived, I again saw the smiling faces of my uncle and aunt and my cousins welcoming me.

units.source_text: 在这里，我又一次闻到了故乡的气息。

en.t: There I once again caught the scent of my hometown.

units.source_text: 那气息对我而言依然亲切如故。

en.t: That scent remained as familiar and dear to me as ever.

units.source_text: 当然，作为打破一个学年的单调生活的调剂，也是很宝贵的。

en.t: Of course, as a change that broke the monotony of an entire school year, it was also very precious.
